## Summary
Describe the change and the problem it addresses.

## Change category
- [ ] UI or user experience
- [ ] API route or provider integration
- [ ] AI analysis or result handling
- [ ] CSV export or data handling
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Repository automation or maintenance

## Validation
- [ ] `npm ci` completed successfully.
- [ ] `npx tsc --noEmit` completed successfully.
- [ ] `npm run build` completed successfully.
- [ ] Affected pages/routes were manually checked where possible.
- [ ] Provider credentials and confidential research data are not included.

## Provider and data impact
List providers, rate limits, response formats, or data fields affected by this change.

## Evidence and limitations
Include screenshots, sanitized logs, test output, and any checks that could not be completed.
